title: POST /api/integration/notify and POST /api/notifications (200)
description: {sent, duplicates} for client_id 'all', else the created notification and whether it was pushed live. With a notification_id that already exists for the same device (integration retry after the hub was unreachable): the existing notification, ws_sent false, duplicate true. For 'all' with a broadcast notification_id the per-device ids are derived (UUIDv5, docs/protocol.md) and devices that already have theirs count as duplicates (nothing created or pushed for them). Watches have no hub connection: 'all' leaves them out, and a notification for one watch goes to the phone that set it up (the notification's client_id is the phone's, the answer names it in forwarded_to); without that phone (deleted, inactive or being deleted) the call is 422 and nothing is stored.

sent.description: Devices that got a new notification (watches are not counted: they show the notifications of their phone).

duplicates.description: Only with a broadcast notification_id: devices that already had the derived id (retry after a timeout or a handover in between).

duplicate.description: Only present when the notification_id already existed (nothing created, nothing pushed).

anyOf.description: One device. For a watch the notification went to the phone that set it up, and the answer carries forwarded_to {client_id, name} of that phone (also with duplicate; the notification_id is checked against the phone).
